product.olivetti-echos-p100d.summary: The P100D paired a dual-scan display with an optional CD-ROM drive.
product.olivetti-echos-p100d.history: Laptopi Muuseum dates its P100D to 1996. In March 1997, Pinus Computer offered it in Finland at FIM 7,950 including tax.
product.olivetti-echos-p100d.architectur: The offer could be expanded with memory or a CD-ROM drive. The advertised configuration had 8 MB, a 510 MB disk and a 10.4-inch screen.
product.olivetti-echos-p100d.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p100d.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-echos-p100d.museum: Laptopi Muuseum, chronological inventory, entries 41 and 199.
